on 14 June, 2024
Author: Anubha Rawat Choudhary

Bench: Anubha Rawat Choudhary
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 Cr. Rev. No. 558 of 2024
 Anand Kumar aged about 36 years, S/o Birendra Yadav, residence of

 East Singhbhum, Jharkhand. ...

 ---
Coram :Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice Anubha Rawat Choudhary
---
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Mukesh Kumar Dubey, Advocate
 For the O.P. : Mr. Lalit Yadav, Advocate
04/14th June 2024
Learned counsel for the parties are present.

2. This Criminal Revision has been filed against the judgment dated 29.04.2024 passed in Cr.
Appeal No. 164 of 2023 whereby and whereunder the learned Additional Sessions Judge,
Jamshedpur has allowed the appeal filed by the informant and has convicted the petitioner for offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced him to undergo rigorous imprisonment for one year with a fine of Rs. 10,000/- with default clause.

The learned trial court had acquitted the petitioner for the offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act vide order dated 23.06.2023 in G.R. Case No. 17 of 2017 arising out of Mango P.S. Case No. 02 of 2017.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this petition has been filed seeking exemption from surrender before the learned trial Court in relation to conviction of the petitioner.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is a bank employee of public sector bank namely, Central Bank of India working as Branch Manager now posted at Mugalsarai Branch,
U.P.

He further submits that the petitioner and the informant has arrived at mutual settlement and Anand Kumar Aged About 36 Years vs The State Of Jharkhand on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152922900/
1 have filed petition for dissolution of marriage before the Principal Judge, Family Court Aurangabad,
Bihar and there is no chance of re-union.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the Opposite Party No. 2 opposes the prayer of the petitioner and submits that the Opposite Party No. 2 has not compromised the criminal case but has only agreed for divorce by mutual consent.

6. After hearing the learned counsel for the parties and considering the facts and circumstances of this case, this Court is of the considered view that merely because the petitioner is a bank employee and that a petition seeking divorce by mutual consent has been filed, the same is not a ground to exempt the petitioner from surrendering before the learned Court.
7. Accordingly, I.A. No. 5086 of 2024 is hereby dismissed.
8. The surrender certificate be filed latest by 27th June 2024 failing which, this criminal revision will stand dismissed without further reference to the Bench.
9. In the meantime, let the records be called for from the concerned Court.

10. Post this case under the heading for final disposal on 28 th June 2024.
11.
Let this order be communicated through 'FAX/e-mail' to the concerned Court.

(Anubha Rawat Choudhary, J.) Aditi Anand Kumar Aged About 36 Years vs The State Of Jharkhand on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152922900/
